item.title: Freeley on site with Wirral demolition
item.description: The contractor is pulling down Woodchurch Leisure Centre, a 1960s swimming pool closed in 2022. The post Freeley on site with Wirral demolition appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Expanded future takes shape for Jennings Brewery
item.description: Stone Circle Developments has launched a consultation as it puts together plans to broaden the appeal of the Cockermouth institution, with a hotel and event space among the possibilities. The post Expanded future takes shape for Jennings Brewery appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Seddon’s SME-focused rethink clears planning
item.description: The developer has secured the go-ahead for 12 flexible business units adding up to 24,700 sq ft at Cheshire Oaks. The post Seddon’s SME-focused rethink clears planning appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Work begins on Protector Insurance’s £5.5m Manchester fit-out
item.description: Flexible Business Interiors has kicked off the project at 3 Hardman Street, with completion expected this summer. The post Work begins on Protector Insurance’s £5.5m Manchester fit-out appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Welsh Govt commits £33m for Rhyl hospital
item.description: The Royal Alexandra Hospital will open a 27,900 sq ft extension in 2027 – more than 13 years since plans to redevelop the facility were first floated. The post Welsh Govt commits £33m for Rhyl hospital appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Plans in for Preston sports village and housing
item.description: Local firm Steel Work Construction and housing provider Community Gateway Association want to build 220 affordable homes off Chipping Lane in Longridge, as well as creating an adjoining multi-sport facility. The post Plans in for Preston sports village and housing appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Rugby acquires Cavendish Walk Shopping Centre for £1.5m
item.description: A key part of Knowsley Council and Genr8 Kajima’s £200m plans to regenerate Huyton town centre, the retail complex comes in at 100,000 sq ft over two levels off Derby Road. The post Rugby acquires Cavendish Walk Shopping Centre for £1.5m appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Preston to approve Praxis’ £98m St John’s vision
item.description: A trio of residential blocks offering up 500 apartments could replace the city centre shopping complex if the city council votes in favour of the plans next week. The post Preston to approve Praxis’ £98m St John’s vision appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: DTZ leans into competitive socialising at Printworks with latest deal
item.description: Gameface will occupy the 5,400 sq ft unit previously home to Bingo Balls, supporting the Manchester complex’s ongoing gamification. The post DTZ leans into competitive socialising at Printworks with latest deal appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cumbrian solar farm hits market with £3.5m price tag
item.description: Currently home to a 7.8MW project with permission in place to grow it by another 10MW, Roanhead Farm offers 268 acres of land by Barrow-in-Furness. The post Cumbrian solar farm hits market with £3.5m price tag appeared first on Place North West.
